title: Sega Ages: Phantasy Star Collection
native_title: セガ・エイジス ファンタシー・スター・コレクション
overview:
Sega Ages: Phantasy Star Collection is a compilation of four Phantasy Star games and was released for the Sega Saturn exclusively in Japan in 1998 as part of the Sega Ages series.

• Phantasy Star
• Phantasy Star II: Kaerazaru Toki no Owari ni
• Phantasy Star III: Toki no Keishousha
• Phantasy Star: Sennenki no Owari ni
